content.value_statement: Financial statements are hard to compare when key ratios are missing. This skill calculates ratios, benchmarks results, and summarizes trends for investment analysis.
actual_capabilities: Calculates profitability ratios including ROE, ROA, gross margin, operating margin, and net margin.
Calculates liquidity, leverage, efficiency, valuation, and per-share metrics from supplied statements.
Interprets ratios with simple ratings, messages, and recommendations.
Compares selected ratios against general and industry benchmark ranges.
Analyzes multi-period ratio trends when historical values are provided.
Generates a concise financial health summary and formatted analysis report text.
limitations: Requires accurate financial statement and market data from the user.
Industry benchmarks are simplified and may not fit every company or sector.
Does not fetch live market prices, filings, or external benchmark data.
Does not provide investment, legal, tax, or accounting advice.

use_cases.title: Screen Public Companies
use_cases.description: Calculate comparable profitability, leverage, liquidity, and valuation ratios before deeper research.

use_cases.title: Review Borrower Health
use_cases.description: Assess liquidity, debt service capacity, and leverage using borrower financial statements.

use_cases.title: Prepare Finance Coursework
use_cases.description: Convert statement figures into ratios, interpretations, and trend comments for class assignments.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate Basic Ratios
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner analysis with one period of statements.
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency, and valuation ratios from these financial statements. Explain each result in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Industry Benchmarks
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ratios for a technology company. Compare the results with relevant benchmark ranges and identify the strongest and weakest areas.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Multi-Period Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these three years of financial data to calculate ratios, identify improving or deteriorating trends, and summarize the key business implications.

prompt_templates.title: Build Investment Memo Inputs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced synthesis for an analyst workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate the ratios, interpret valuation and financial health, highlight risks, and draft concise inputs for an investment memo.

output_examples.input: A company provides one year of income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and market data.
output: Profitability: ROE is strong, while net margin is moderate.
Liquidity: Current ratio suggests adequate short-term coverage.
Leverage: Debt-to-equity indicates a conservative capital structure.
Valuation: P/E suggests the shares trade near fair value.

output_examples.input: A retailer provides three years of current ratio, debt-to-equity, ROE, and gross margin values.
output: Trend analysis shows improving ROE and stable liquidity.
Gross margin remains below the retail benchmark range.
Priority recommendation: Review pricing, inventory costs, and supplier terms.

best_practices: Provide complete income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and market data when available.
Specify the company industry so benchmark comparisons use the closest available context.
Review ratio outputs against filings, notes, and business context before making decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat ratio outputs as standalone investment advice.
Do not compare companies from different industries without adjusting the interpretation.
Do not rely on missing or estimated inputs without clearly labeling the assumptions.

faq.question: What financial ratios can this skill calculate?
faq.answer: It covers profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency, valuation, and per-share metrics.

faq.question: Can it analyze trends over time?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide historical ratio values and period labels to receive trend direction and change commentary.

faq.question: Does it download market data or filings?
faq.answer: No. The skill works with financial and market data that the user supplies.

faq.question: Can it compare results with industry benchmarks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes simplified benchmark ranges for several industries and a general fallback.

faq.question: Is this suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this replace professional financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports analysis, but users should validate outputs with qualified financial, tax, or accounting experts.
